title: Evaluate TVC SES receipts against transition-native controls
originating_goal: Run the transition-native AI construction experiment without duplicating the executable SES construction lane or contaminating it with later-stage labels.
machine_owner: StegCore repository heartbeat -> existing StegVerse control plane
claim_expires_or_releases_when: TVC task TVC-SES-EXPERIMENT-RUN-023 emits a complete immutable end-to-end receipt bundle and terminal observation record suitable for post-hoc evaluation.
dependencies: immutable ordered SES transition/state receipt bundle exists
machine_outputs: post-hoc mapping of observed SES capabilities to StegCore experimental criteria
blind-threshold status: NOT_YET_POSSIBLE, POSSIBLE_UNCONFIRMED, OBSERVED_ONCE, REPRODUCED, CAUSALLY_SUPPORTED, or CAPABILITY_UNLOCKED
collision_boundaries: Do not build a second SES construction harness in StegCore while TVC owns the executable construction/run lane.
Do not feed stage 0-8 labels, ALLOW/DENY vocabulary, admissibility definition text, autonomy labels, or goal-seeking labels into TVC SES construction.
Do not reinterpret workflow success, merge state, or capability count as autonomy.
Do not use GITHUB_TOKEN, GH_TOKEN, STEGVERSE_GITHUB_TOKEN, or any non-TV/TVC credential fallback.
Do not grant execution, release, publication, Master Record, wallet, trade, or production authority.
machine_trigger: Repository heartbeat observes completion of TVC-SES-EXPERIMENT-RUN-023 and availability of its immutable receipt bundle.
machine_observable_release_conditions: TVC end-to-end experiment run reports COMPLETE.
Exact source/evidence identities for the TVC run are available.
Post-hoc evaluation can consume the receipt bundle without adding construction inputs.
Any missing held-out, sham, causal-ablation, or blind-evaluation evidence is reported as an evidence gap rather than inferred as success.
next_task_after_complete: Use observed evaluation gaps to decide whether StegCore needs additional held-out/sham/ablation tooling; do not duplicate the TVC construction runner.
